speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Choledocholithiasis with Common Bile Duct Obstruction. The ultrasound showing ductal dilation and a cystic mass, combined with your cholestatic lab results (elevated direct bilirubin and alkaline phosphatase) and classic obstructive jaundice symptoms (pale stools, dark urine, pruritus), confirms a blockage in the common bile duct, most likely by a stone. The "cystic mass" noted on the ultrasound is consistent with a distended gallbladder (Courvoisier's sign).
